notes.title: Community Events!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Our first large update and our first-ever community event, "Mushroom Mania," just went live on mobile![/p][p align="start"]We've introduced monthly community events, as well as daily challenges, after numerous requests by our community. Here's how it works:[/p][list][*][p]The whole community needs to work together to save their kingdom from invasive fungi.[/p][/*][*][p]You contribute by placing Forest tiles. You get 1 mushroom per Forest square placed.[/p][/*][*][p]The community must work together and collect a total of 60,000 mushrooms to complete the event![/p][/*][*][p]If we reach the community goals, everyone will receive exclusive rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also contribute by completing daily challenges (these also give you Shards for your Lost Kingdom). You get fresh new dailies every day.[/p][/*][*][p]There are leaderboards showing top contributors.[/p][/*][*][p]You can spend leftover Shards to boost your contribution or refresh challenges.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The idea is to make the game feel alive by giving players new daily content, while keeping the core Kingdomino gameplay fresh with a different focus each month.[/p][p align="start"]But here's the thing - we've not seen anything quite like this in digital board games before, so we're genuinely curious to hear your thoughts on the feature when it arrives on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][b]In the meantime, is there anything else you would like to see as a feature within Kingdomino? Is there something you think we have missed or would like to see on the roadmap? Let us know below[/b][/p]

notes.title: Kingdomino is now available on iOS and Android!
notes.content: [p]The official Kingdomino tabletop board game has landed on iOS and Android! Play the critically acclaimed tabletop strategy game on your mobile or tablet device. Explore your territory and compete with other lords to build the best Kingdom![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568339/e270eca1f3fd3f6178fcca281551825f9f2d17c8.png"][/img][/p][p]As we continue to work on the Steam version, which will be released later this year, we'd like to give you a sneak peek of what's included in the mobile version.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay Features:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Uncover Your Lost Kingdom[/b]: Place mystery dominoes and unlock new cosmetics and rewards within a unique Kingdomino-style environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A Living World:[/b] Players can watch their kingdom come alive with charming animations and dynamic environments with details in every tile.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Modes and Quests:[/b] Play solo or with friends across a range of games, from battling AI to online public, or players can play against friends privately![/p][/*][*][p][b]Touch-Optimised Interface[/b]: Intuitive drag-and-drop or tap to place controls explicitly designed for Kingdomino on mobile devices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards & Competition: Climb the ranks and conquer the crown. Players can test their skills and see how they stack up against rulers from around the world.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Crossplay:[/b] Build, compete, and connect across multiple gaming platforms. Play with anyone, anywhere, anytime.[/p][/*][/list][p]The mobile versions include support for English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Polish, and Russian, with more to come in the future in time for the Steam launch later this year.[/p][p][/p][p]Find out more here: [url="https://meeplecorp.com/kingdomino/"]https://meeplecorp.com/kingdomino/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568339/e23bc58296396e05025de23f8efa9c8e81ae34d5.png"][/img][/p]
